title: Bismarck Sea Pumice Blocks Sea Access Manus Province
description: Pumice from Titan Ridge submarine eruption has washed ashore on Admiralty Islands, blocking sea access in Manus Province, Papua New Guinea. Boan village on Lou Island is particularly affected, with trade, fishing, and medical access severely disrupted. Reported by The Watchers on June 11, 2026.
update_details: Pumice washed ashore blocking sea access; trade/fishing/medical access disrupted at Boan village, Lou Island

confidence_factors.notes: The Watchers report with ground-level detail; satellite confirmation of pumice raft expected
